title: Waiver of notice.
bodyText: A person may waive notice, in writing, signed by the person or the person's attorney and filed in the proceeding. However, a respondent, ward, or protected person may not waive notice.
bodyHtml: §560:5-114  Waiver of notice.  A person may waive notice, in writing, signed by the person or the person's attorney and filed in the proceeding.  However, a respondent, ward, or protected person may not waive notice. [L 2004, c 161, pt of §1]
